title: Garlic Fried Rice
description: Sinangag. Day-old rice fried in garlic oil with a heavy hand of fried garlic folded back through at the end. A side dish that quietly outshines what it is served with.
notes: Freshly cooked rice will not work — it steams and clumps. Cold rice from yesterday is the requirement, not a shortcut.

ingredients.name: cooked rice
ingredients.note: cold, from the day before, broken up by hand

steps.text: Fry the minced garlic in the neutral oil over a medium-low heat until pale gold, then lift half of it out onto paper.
steps.tip: Pull it while it is lighter than you want — it keeps browning on the paper. Burnt garlic is bitter and unfixable.

steps.text: Turn the heat up, add the cold cooked rice to the garlic oil left in the pan, and press it into an even layer.
Leave it alone so the underside crisps, then turn and repeat.
steps.tip: Constant stirring gives you warm rice. Stillness gives you texture.

steps.text: Season with the salt, fold through the reserved crisp garlic and the spring onions, and serve with a fried egg.
